Those two preservation options are the right split, and it’s fine for a local copy and an Internet Archive link to coexist.

One correction: please don’t decide it is a PDF only because the address ends in `.pdf`. Some download links return a PDF without showing that extension. The finished app should recognise the file it receives and preserve it as a PDF whenever it actually is one. With that condition, page preservation is complete and we can move to import/export.
